jobs_results.title: Salesforce Developer
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM Consulting is looking for a Salesforce Developer that would like to collaborate with one of the top 15 global pharmaceutical companies.

Main responsabilities:
• Develop software according to user requirements, functional and technical design specifications.
• Perform and assist with quality assurance activities as needed.
• Asses, troubleshoot, document, upgrade and develop maintenance procedures.
• Review code for potential performance issues, reusability and/ or anomalies.

Mandatory Skills:
• At least 2+ years of experience as a Salesforce Developer
• Experience in developing complex solutions on Sales in Salesforce
• Experience in developing lightning components desired.
• Development technologies (APEX, Visualforce, migration tools, SOQL, web services).
• Understanding of both DevOps/Agile (SCRUM) and Waterfall delivery principles and the importance of SDLC (Software Development Process) and coding methodology principles is a plus
• Should be able to work in a self... managing way and should take Accountability of all assigned applications
• Excellent spoken and written English.
• Experience working in an international and intercultural environment and availability to travel.
• Knowledge on Veeva CRM is valuable
• Salesforce Platform Developer I certification is a must.
• Any other Salesforce certification is a plus

WHAT DO WE OFFER
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Trainings & Certifications. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention.

About us

We are a digital global company whose mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, #LifeandSciences, #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility, #commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

jobs_results.title: CRM - Salesforce Business Systems Analyst 3
jobs_results.description:
The worldwide data management software market is massive (According to IDC, the worldwide database software market, which it refers to as the database management systems software market, was forecasted to be approximately $82 billion in 2023 growing to approximately $137 billion in 2027. This represents a 14% compound annual growth rate). At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading developer data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

We have a fantastic opportunity for an individual to join the Core CRM Team at MongoDB. The Core CRM Team works cross functionally with Stakeholders across Marketing & Sales improving and enhancing the Sales process for our Customers. Specifically Lead Flow & Intelligence. (MQL Process, CRMA, Lead Routing etc)

We are looking to speak to candidates who can work remotely... within Spain, and there is also the opportunity to work from our Madrid or Barcelona offices (hybrid in office/work from home).

Responsibilities:
• Configuring the Lightning Platform (Sales Cloud) to the Business Needs using automation tools
• QA Testing (Peer, Functional)
• Facilitate workshops with stakeholders to drive out requirements
• Create process flow diagrams
• Solution Design
• Investigating production issues
• Ability to work independently with limited supervision, whilst participating fully as a member of the team
• Improving existing processes and sharing runbooks
• End User Communication

Required Skills And Experience
• Over 5+ Years of Salesforce experience within an end user or consultancy environment
• Must have at least or equivalent experience;
• * Salesforce Certified Administrator
• Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
• Salesforce Certified Business Analyst
• Salesforce Sales Cloud Consultant
• Strong understanding of Salesforce Architecture and best practices
• Intermediate Knowledge of Deployment Life Cycle (Build, QA, UAT)
• 3rd Party App integrations experience (SalesLoft, Q-Assign, Lean Data, Insideview, Linkedin Sales Navigator)
• Stakeholder management
• Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements
• Analytical mindset (Understanding the why behind the request)
• Has deep understanding of Agile Methodologies
• Knowledge of IDEs (Visual Studio, Gear Set, Git Hub)
• Knowledge of process mapping tools (Lucid Chart)
• Identifying risks and issues to the team to fix them in a timely manner

Nice to haves
• Ability to understand Apex code and triggers
• Understanding of CRMA

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

"MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer

jobs_results.title: Implantador Salesforce - Marketing Cloud | España
jobs_results.description:
UNISYS, empresa multinacional con más de 23.000 empleados a nivel mundial, se encuentra en búsqueda de profesionales en implementación de Salesforce para ejecutar proyectos en grandes clientes de Sector Energético y Utilities de Ibex 35.

Qué profesional buscamos?

Profesional con 3 años de experiencia minimo como implantador en Salesforce - Marketing Cloud:
• Experiencia en herramientas de gestión de tickets, tipo Jira.
• Experiencia en Marketing Cloud.
• Definición y ejecución de planes de pruebas.
• Trasladar requerimientos de negocio en soluciones sobre Marketing Cloud
• Realizar las configuraciones necesarias sobre todos los módulos de Marketing Cloud
• Muy valorable, experiencia en Interlocución con cliente y en nubes como Sales, Service o Field Service.

¿Qué puede ser un valor diferenciador?
• Poseer certificaciones. Salesforce Service Cloud
• Experiencia en Sector Energético.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Contrato indefinido.
• Plan de carrera a medida, orientado a crecimiento y... aprendizaje continuo.
• Formación continuada, tanto técnica como competencial (clases de inglés, cursos de habilidades blandas, etc).
• Proyectos dinámicos y en grandes Clientes (Ibex35 – Energía & Utilities)
• Interesante plan de retribución flexible: seguro de vida, seguro médico, tickets guardería, tickets restaurante, tickets transporte

Omega CRM, a leader in Technology Solutions, is looking to develop its Marketing practice with a Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consultant.

Main duties:
• Investigate, create, and recommend innovative marketing automation and martech solutions.
• Conduct analysis on marketing automation and martech solution implementations. Assist in high-level architecture design for marketing automation and martech solution implementations by choosing the most suitable platform.
• Implement infrastructure and functional cloud marketing architecture.
• Create policies for activating automated communications that map the customer's journey.
• Perform basic functional and specialized marketing tasks.
• Ensure that automated cloud communication activations are effectively utilized.
• Decide which processes are suitable and necessary to be executed in the cloud for implementing marketing automation solutions.
• Determine the assets and organization of automations that best fit the cloud implementation.
•... Provide functional consulting services to ensure that automated communication processes run smoothly.

• Implement the latest technological advancements and marketing technology solutions.
• Conduct test trials, diagnose errors, and resolve issues in the use of marketing automation and martech tools.

Experience:
• Proven experience in creating marketing campaigns with Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
• Knowledge with Ampscript is a plus.
• Previous experience in database management, preferably in a similar role.
• Knowledge with the automation software and relevant performance evaluation.

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Technical Administrator
jobs_results.description:
🛫 WHO ARE WE ? 🛫

FCM Travel is one of the largest and fastest-growing global business travel management companies with a worldwide reach in almost 100 countries. FCM in Barcelona represents a tribe of more than 110 teammates, united by a single mission: developing and ensuring the best services and technology products to support business travelers in their trips around the globe.

🚀 THE JOB

We are seeking a Technical Administrator that is motivated to provide advice and guidance around technical design decisions on our Salesforce platform, carry out key platform administration responsibilities, with a focus on low code configuration. You will be responsible for managing the Salesforce Platform as well as delivering enhancements and enabling new features/products to support our business needs. This role is analytical, hands-on, and the right candidate enjoys digging into requirements and working towards a solution in a collaborative environment.

We have recently completed... rebuilding our 15+ year legacy Salesforce instance. Our focus now is to continue to add value by enabling our business through technology while further globalizing our people and processes. The business processes we enable in our Salesforce are end to end as we cover Marketing, Sales, Implementations, Account Management, Operations, and Support. We have also recently deployed an Omni Channel solution that is critical to our business and their interactions with customers. This is leveraging Service Cloud and will continue to expand with the use of Service Cloud Voice, Einstein, GPT, and integrations with our other important platforms. This is truly an amazing opportunity to help take FCTG to the next level and change the way we do business with our customers while strengthening our position as a leader in travel tech.

🎯 YOUR MISSIONS
• Align business processes with Salesforce best practices and help ensure solutions deliver measurable business benefits
• Collaborate on solution design
• Assist with translating functional business requirements to technical design focused on enabling the business and support creation of User Stories within a Product Backlog
• Assist with identifying unnecessary technical debt
• Provide escalated technical user support – particularly post deployment (bugs/issues and data requests where Level 1, 2, 3 support teams require assistance)
• Design, configure, develop solutions using the full Salesforce toolset focused on declarative first
• Configure objects, fields, page layouts, lightning record pages, record types, etc in SFDC, ensuring alignment with requirements and existing security and structure
• Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to review business process and optimization of current solutions
• Review, manage, regression test - Salesforce releases (3x per year)
• Assist with testing/QA (Peer Review)
• Support UAT process by working with Business Analyst and key stakeholders on developing and executing test plans
• Support Deployment process by working within Sandbox environments and moving components through environments
• Work with Developers to provide direction where advanced solutions are required
• Create and maintain detailed documentation for technical design, case/ticket notes, lessons learned
• Communicate and update project status for tasks assigned
• Work with Support, Governance, Enablement teams on roll out to Users

👀 Our Ideal Candidate ?
• 3-5 years hands on experience with Salesforce, ideally with an administration role
• Certified Salesforce Administrator or higher
• Experience with Lightning UI
• Experience in training and supporting nontechnical staff in the use of Salesforce
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as troubleshooting expertise
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
• Ability to prioritize effectively and escalate issues as required
• Strong working knowledge of Salesforce configuration (Process Builder, Formula fields, Validation rules)
• Strong ability to develop and support Salesforce analytics including complex reporting and dashboards
• Experience working with Agile development teams using SCRUM
• Strong ability to perform data cleansing and mass updates for users
• Demonstrates constructive conflict resolution skills to ensure a positive outcome for all involved
• Maintains objectivity and can see the big picture rather than reacting emotionally to the problem
• Knows how to embrace conflict to achieve a win/win outcome for all parties involved
• Knows how to use available resources to solve problems
• Thinks outside the box when overcoming problems
• Encourages and assists other team members to solve problems
• Experience with implementing Salesforce is an asset
• Experience with deployments is preferred
• Strong understanding of Salesforce core data model (Sales & Service Cloud)

🎁 WHY FCM SPAIN ?

As well as being a fun company to work :
• We offer you an interesting package: Participation in the private mutual insurance company + Attractive remuneration
• 30 days off/year + reduced time during summer + Barcelona bank holidays
• Discounts to access your favorite gym (Andjoy app!)
• Free language platform
• Employee Retention share scheme
• Several activities organized by the ambassadors!
• Free coffee, drinks, snacks and fruits at the office!
• A modern and human management focused on personal development, to support you in the evolution of your career

We truly think personality is important so bring it on

jobs_results.title: Salesforce CRM Consultant
jobs_results.description:
Sobre CoverManager...

Somos una startup tecnológica con presencia nacional e internacional líder en software de gestión de reservas. Nuestra misión consiste en ofrecer a los restaurantes soluciones de tecnología y hospitality que les ayuden a crecer y estar más cerca de sus clientes. Además, nos mueve mejorar la vida de las personas que trabajan en la industria de la Hospitality ayudándoles a ofrecer experiencias únicas a sus clientes.

Como referentes en el sector, nuestro SaaS es usado por clientes repartidos por todo el mundo. Algunos de ellos son grandes nombres de la restauración como Amazónico, Arzabal, El Campero, Aponiente, Diverxo, El Celler de Can Roca, Grupo Dani García, Ovejas Negras, Pacha, Mirazur, etc.

Para hacer realidad nuestra misión necesitamos un equipo que comparta los valores y principios de COVER ya que impregnan todo lo que hacemos y son parte de nuestra cultura (constancia,esfuerzo, honestidad, pasión por lo que hacemos, innovación continua poniendo al... cliente en el centro, etc.).

Oportunidad de empleo...

Para ayudarnos a seguir creciendo, actualmente estamos buscando un/a Salesforce CRM Consultant para nuestra sede en Sevilla. Buscamos a una persona muy resolutiva y con actitud positiva y comunicativa, que quiera desarrollarse y crecer profesionalmente dentro del sector.

Buscamos una persona con experiencia en...
• Al menos 1 año de experiencia práctica con Salesforce.
• Conocimiento de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau o Power BI es altamente valorado.
• Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y en equipo, con una fuerte orientación a resultados.
• Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración para trabajar con diversos equipos internos.
• Formación a través de Trailhead de Salesforce es un valor agregado.

Valoramos muy positivamente tener conocimientos en...
• Certificación en Salesforce
• Idioma Inglés.
• Experiencia en el sector de la restauración.
• Producto SaaS.
• Ecosistema startup.

jobs_results.title: CRM Manager (Salesforce Marketing Cloud)
jobs_results.description:
What is Exoticca?

Do you like traveling? Do you enjoy the exotic? Do you like strong challenges? If the answer is YES, welcome to Exoticca!

Exoticca is a company that started in 2013 by professionals specialized in the creation and online distribution of voyages. Our mission is to offer our clients the possibility to visit the most beautiful and stimulating places on our planet, through the best holiday packages, at unbelievable prices. For more comfort, our customers can find out more about our trips and book them instantly in a matter of minutes through our website, avoiding the usual long exchanges of emails, meetings, or calls required by more traditional travel agencies.

At Exoticca we are looking for people who want to offer their best to create unforgettable experiences for our customers. We are a young, dynamic, multicultural team of 350+ people, in rapid international growth, seeking for new partners to help us create the best and most forward-thinking travel company of... our generation.

We are a highly ambitious and well-funded start-up, backed by top national and international investors that have also participated in the growth of other success stories, such as Glovo or Idealista.

What is our proposal?

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CRM Manager to join our team. As the CRM Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing strategies to optimize our interactions with customers across various channels. You will lead a team to drive customer engagement, retention, and satisfaction through effective CRM initiatives.

Which will be your main responsibilities?
• Strategy Development: Develop and execute comprehensive CRM strategies aligned with company goals to enhance customer acquisition, retention, and loyalty.
• Customer Segmentation: Utilize data analysis and segmentation techniques to identify and target key customer segments, tailoring communication and marketing efforts accordingly.
• Customer Journey Mapping: Develop and optimize customer journey maps to understand customer touchpoints and drive personalized interactions throughout the customer lifecycle.
• Communication Planning: Oversee the planning, creation and optimization of all communications across the customer lifecycle, including triggered campaigns and highly personalized communications.
• CRM Technology Management: Lead the seamless implementation and ongoing optimization of our CRM platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, using tools like Automation Studio, Journey Builder, and others.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with marketing, product, sales, customer service, and other departments to ensure seamless integration of CRM initiatives across the organization.
• Data Analytics: Leverage data analytics and performance metrics to measure the effectiveness of CRM campaigns and initiatives, and to identify areas for improvement.
• Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a highly talented team of CRM professionals, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities to foster a high-performing and collaborative work environment.

Requirements:
• Proven experience 5+ in CRM management, with a track record of successfully developing and implementing CRM strategies in a complex organization.
• In-depth knowledge of CRM principles, methodologies, and best practices.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, draw insights, and make data-driven decisions.
• Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and proficiency in data analytics tools (e.g. Looker).
• Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and influence stakeholders at all levels.
• Demonstrated ability to manage projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Fluency in English.

Benefits
• Competitive compensation package in line with job responsibilities and experience.
• Flexible compensation on transportation and food with Cobee also in our private health insurance.
• Hybrid work model: you can work from home or the office at your convenience. Offices in the heart of Barcelona (right next to Plaça Catalunya).
• Permanent contract from the start.
• Travel at reduced prices!
• Referral bonus, if you bring people as talented as you.
• And last but not least, becoming part of a fun and motivated multicultural team at an agile and rapid growing organization!

Exoticca is an equal opportunity employer. Diversity and inclusiveness are our core. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under European, country, or local law

jobs_results.title: Consultor/a Funcional Salesforce
jobs_results.description:
¿Buscas un cambio profesional? ¿Te gustaría encontrar una empresa en donde formarte en las últimas tecnologías del mercado en proyectos de larga duración?

UNISYS, empresa multinacional con más de 23.000 empleados a nivel mundial, se encuentra en búsqueda de un Consultor Funcional Salesforce con experiencia en Sales Cloud y Service Cloud, para ejecutar proyectos en grandes clientes de Sector Energético y Utilities de Ibex 35.

Buscamos incorporar un perfil con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en Salesforce, con experiencia en implantaciones/mantenimiento.

Requisitos:
• Estudios: Licenciatura Superior/Diplomatura.
• Imprescindible conocimiento funcional en SAP Salesforce, en Sales Cloud y Service Cloud.
• Experiencia: mínimo 2 años en consultoría o empresas del sector realizando implantaciones, mantenimientos o evolutivos de Salesforce.
• Conocimiento de las nubes Sales y/o Service,
• Experiencia en interlocución con cliente.

Funciones:

- Participar de forma activa en proyectos de... implantación y evolutivos.

- Proponer soluciones de cara al cliente.

- Toma de Requisitos.

- Parametrizaciones.

- Capacidad de organización y priorización.

Te ofrecemos:

- Contrato indefinido.

-Modelo 100% remoto

- Plan de carrera a medida, orientado a crecimiento y aprendizaje continuo.

- Formación continuada, tanto técnica como competencial (clases de inglés, cursos de Skills interpersonales...).

- Proyectos dinámicos y en grandes Clientes (IBEX35).

- Interesante plan de retribución flexible: seguro de vida, seguro médico, tickets guardería, tickets restaurante, tickets transporte

jobs_results.title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Developer
jobs_results.description:
Humanizando la Tecnología.

Somos una gran empresa con alma de start-up. Nos organizamos por unidades de conocimiento expertas que colaboran entre sí.

Por ello buscamos personas inquietas, que les motiven los retos y con ganas de crecer personal y profesionalmente, que se unan a nuestro equipo para tener un impacto positivo en el mundo a través de la tecnología.

¿TE APUNTAS AL RETO?

Queremos que formes parte del nuestro equipo de SALESFORCE SERVICES, como SALESFORCE MARKETING CLOUD DEVELOPER.

Llevamos más de 16 años acompañando a las empresas en su transformación digital. Somos pioneros con el máximo nivel de partnership de Salesforce, CRM #1 del mundo. Lideramos proyectos de impacto que abarcan desde la consultoría, la implantación, la configuración y la parametrización de las diferentes nubes de Salesforce, incluyendo también la integración con todos los sistemas de la compañía.

¿SOBRE EL PUESTO?
• Diseño de soluciones de carácter técnico para funcionalidades no cubiertas... out-of-the-box por Salesforce Marketing Cloud
• Documentación técnica
• Desarrollos de scripts personalizados sobre la plataforma, para su uso tanto en el canal email como en Cloud Pages, incluyendo AMPScript, JS o SSJS
• Diseño y construcción de soluciones de integración con sistemas externos vía API y/o ficheros
• Creación de paquetes aceleradores para la agilización de tareas del día a día en la herramienta

¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?
• Experiencia mínima de 2-3 años en desarrollos sobre Salesforce Marketing Cloud
• Dominio de los lenguajes de programación propios de la plataforma
• Destreza en el manejo de consultas SQL complejas
• Conocimientos de lenguajes como HTML, JS y SSJS
• Capacidad de auto-organización y seriedad en el cumplimiento de plazos establecidos

Se valorará positivamente:
• Conocimiento otros productos Salesforce (MCP, Data Cloud, Sales/Service Cloud)
• Soltura en la redacción de documentación orientada a diferentes perfiles de usuarios (funcionales, negocio y técnicos)
• Capacidad de comunicación regular, oral y escrita, con cliente
• Nivel medio/alto de inglés oral y/o escrito
• Conocimientos de sistemas de control de versiones

¿QUÉ PODRÁS ENCONTRAR EN SEIDOR?

· Colaboración con un gran equipo de profesionales donde contarás con un plan de carrera ajustado a tus expectativas.

· El teletrabajo en nuestro ADN 🙌

· Flexibilidad horaria, jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año y los meses de julio y agosto.

· Formaciones técnicas y en inglés o el idioma que elijas🚀

· Retribución flexible: Tickets restaurante, guardería, transporte y seguro médico.

· Si tienes inquietudes internacionales, estamos en 44 países 🌍

· Programa de referencias: si traes a un amig@, tiene premio

· Club de descuentos exclusivo: ocio, tecnología, hogar, viajes... 🌟

· Oportunidad de ser parte de la Oficina Virtual en Bankinter con condiciones muy especiales.

💜 Compromiso con la diversidad e igualdad de oportunidades.

💚 Decimos “Hola” al mundo en más de 30 idiomas, y lo hacemos con responsabilidad y compromiso con el desarrollo social y el medio ambiente.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo, en proyectos que cambien el mundo!

#SEIDORHumanFocused

#HumanizandoLaTecnología

jobs_results.title: Arquitecto/a Salesforce
jobs_results.description:
SegurCaixa Adeslas es la compañía No Vida líder en España en seguros de salud, integrada en el Grupo Mutua Madrileña y participada por CaixaBank.

En los últimos años se ha convertido en una entidad de referencia gracias a la implantación de un modelo de negocio basado en el crecimiento sostenido y rentable, que sitúa al cliente en el centro de la estrategia. A través de su acuerdo de bancaseguros con CaixaBank, SegurCaixa Adeslas comercializa sus productos en la mayor red bancaria de España. Adicionalmente, la aseguradora cuenta con una red tradicional con más de 4.000 puntos de venta y atención al cliente.

Estamos convencid@s de que las personas son el principal valor de nuestra compañía y por eso SegurCaixa Adeslas se muestra absolutamente comprometida con la igualdad de oportunidades entre hombres y mujeres. Nuestro Plan de Igualdad persigue hacer efectivo este principio y por ello, el proceso de selección de nuestras ofertas garantiza la igualdad de oportunidades a todas las... candidaturas.

En la actualidad, estamos en plena transformación tecnológica y necesitamos reforzar el equipo de Digitalización de Clientes con un Responsable Técnico de Salesforce (perfil técnicamente potente)

REQUISITOS
• Experiencia demostrable como Responsable Técnico Salesforce en empresas y proyectos de gran tamaño.
• Conocimientos y experiencia metodología agile
• Se valorará conocimientos y experiencia trabajando con el modelo de datos de Salesforce e integraciones.
• Conocimientos avanzados de Salesforce.
• Certificaciones requeridas: Salesforce Technical Arquitect (application or system architect).
• VALORABLE: 5 certificaciones Salesforce (architect)

FUNCIONES
• Visión estratégica sobre los distintos proyectos Salesforce de SCA, manteniéndose al día de las novedades incorporadas en cada nueva reléase de fabricante.
• Garantiza diseño de soluciones para implantaciones Salesforce acorde con las best practices del fabricante y la propia arquitectura y estándares de SCA
• Garantiza la reutilización de soluciones. Aportando soluciones específicas a problemas complejos.
• Capacidad de identificar problemas de seguridad inherente a los desarrollos Salesforce y proponer soluciones.
• Ofrecer asesoramiento especializado a los responsables de los desarrollos Salesforce para asegurar la escalabilidad de la solución, reducir riesgos y corregir problemas de rendimiento.
• Liderar sesiones de Design authority en las que sea capaz de entender los diseños técnicos planteados por los diferentes proyectos/labs y validarlos o reencaminar hacia diseños alineados con la estrategia global de diseño, sostenibilidad de software y eficiencia de la plataforma, así como la convivencia con el resto de apps de la organización.
• Verificar el diseño del software mediante la construcción y aplicación de los métodos apropiados.
• Realizar un seguimiento proactivo del estado de los límites de la plataforma y procesos desarrollados por los proyectos.
• Liderar e impulsar las actividades necesarias para garantizar la estabilidad de la plataforma o una baja performance del software.
• Seguimiento de la monitorización de la plataforma en entorno productivo y sandboxes para detectar anomalías, incidencias o puntos de mejora.
• Apoyo a los diferentes proyectos de cada ámbito Salesforce para la consecución de los objetivos.

¿Eres tu la persona que estamos buscando? Envíanos tu Cv
